title: DeathRecordResponse
description: Standard response envelope carrying one death registration record. The published collection has no successful example for the death endpoints (the sample institution is authorised for birth services only, so both saved examples are 403s), so the returned field set is left open rather than guessed.

api_code.description: HTTP-style status code repeated in the body.

api_data.description: The death registration record. Field set not documented upstream — see the schema description.
